messages:
mina: quick sync  proposal: retire permissive org-scoped API keys for runtime services. default policy: reject org-wildcard tokens at gateway unless short-lived brokered or allowlisted.
rajesh: curious about customer impact. any public APIs using org keys?
mina: mostly internal CI and a few infra jobs. risk is high when org keys leak.
zoe: +1 for safer defaults. migration plan idea: detection-only first, owner notifications, deploy-lint failure, then deny-with-allowlist.
carl: enforcement surface? gateway makes sense so we can roll per-cluster and centralize metrics. audit-bot: policy staged: scope_restrictions=detect@gateway-canary.
rajesh: how to detect "org-wildcard"? suggestion: key.meta.scopes==["*"] OR key.binding=="org" && !key.projects. keep rule simple and documented.
mina: agree. UX change: during creation show a banner: "Org keys are broad; for runtime services use project tokens or brokered tokens." default TTL 7d for org keys.
zoe: long-term: implement a token-broker. services authenticate with their service identity, request project-scoped token from broker. broker checks ACLs and mints ephemeral tokens (min TTL, tied to original principal).
carl: broker should support batched minting for bulk jobs to avoid per-project thundering. also include a way to pre-authorize a set of projects for a principal.
rajesh: RBAC mapping question: how do we express cross-project roles? broker ACLs could reference role tuples like (service_principal, project_id, role). store as compact ACLs.
mina: tracing/audit requirement: always propagate origin_key_id and broker_subject to logs and traces. SIEM should be able to link actions back to principal and assumed project.
zoe: ops exception flow: allow a timeboxed allowlist entry with owner, justification, and expiration; require manual review for >30d.
carl: rollout checklist: 1) gateway detect-only 2) collect owner list 3) deploy-lint rule and docs 4) enable deny-by-default in canary with allowlist 5) broker PoC 6) full rollout + deprecation notices.
mina: i'll draft RFC with timeline and add a migration sheet for teams. can folks review RFC this week?
rajesh: can review Thu.
zoe: can review.
carl: can review.
audit-bot: created ticket INFRA-5201 for scope enforcement and INFRA-5202 for broker PoC.
